title: code_index.language_server request
description: Whether a rename of a file would reach a language server, decided by the lookup `rename_symbol` uses and without starting a process. The lookup checks the server's override variable, the project's own bin directory, `PATH`, then per-user and Homebrew install directories, and skips a rustup proxy whose toolchain lacks the component or a `tsc` older than TypeScript 7.

path.description: Workspace-relative or absolute path to the file a rename would start from.

root.description: Workspace root. Defaults to the index root, else the current directory.
